gloss: roadside; wayside; side of the road

definitions.gloss: roadside; wayside; edge of the road
definitions.explanation: The edge or side of a road or street, especially the strip just beside where people walk or drive.

examples.japanese: {道端|みちばた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Flowers are blooming by the roadside.

examples.japanese: {道端|みちばた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{子猫|こねこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}った→拾う：00845_hirou⟧。
examples.english: I picked up a kitten on the side of the road.

examples.japanese: {道端|みちばた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}り{込|こ}んで→座り込む：04641_suwarikomu⟧、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見上|みあ}げていた→見上げる：04567_miageru⟧。
examples.english: I sat down by the roadside and gazed up at the sky for a while.

notes:
{道端|みちばた} refers to the side or edge of a road. The {端|ばた} element (a voiced form of {端|はた}) means 'edge.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道端|みちばた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: by the roadside (location)
- {道端|みちばた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at the roadside (where an action happens)
- {道端|みちばた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧: roadside grass

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{路肩|ろかた}→路肩：20701_rokata⟧: road shoulder — the paved edge of a road for vehicles
- ⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧: sidewalk — a designated walkway
